chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 227 — Ji Ning takes revenge on Shui Yi and returns to Winged Serpent Lake.
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning executes his second enemy, Shui Yi, with a cruel but just technique, then returns home to Winged Serpent Lake for a quiet reunion with Autumn Leaf.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 227 — Two Down, One to Go
og_description: Ji Ning kills Shui Yi in poetic justice, then returns to the lake where it all began.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 227 — Revenge, then home
twitter_description: Ji Ning finishes Shui Yi and drifts home to Winged Serpent Lake.

lore_anchors.definition: A non-combat torture technique that inflicts excruciating internal agony; used by Ji Ning on Shui Yi as poetic justice rather than tactical necessity.
The internal points/merits system of the Yinglong Guard, earned through missions and combat, used to exchange for techniques and treasures.
A Xianxia concept where a cultivator's starting point, clan, and emotional bonds are considered part of their spiritual foundation.
The dimensional space within a Ki Refiner's body that stores their Yuan power; shattering it cripples a cultivator permanently.
